name: devcorner
description: Connects Claude Code to devcorner, which you sign in to from /mcp: opens and closes a devcorner session with each conversation and moves it to the branch you switch to, registers each subagent as a child session, and puts new messages in front of the model while it works, one line each, asking devcorner only when something waits. When something wakes a waiting session, such as your answer from devcorner, the end of a run it asked for or its pull request's conflict, an idle conversation starts a turn for it, naming what came, once and only while it is unread. A conversation with no session is woken by your own message to it, and other mail to it is told on a toast. /devcorner:cloud-agent sets up your Claude Code routine for cloud runs in one step, and /devcorner:discuss talks a question waiting on you through in the session you are in, posting nothing until you say so. A quiet line above the prompt, drawn by devcorner itself with no warning sign, is one line of links with nothing to press: devcorner, linked to the project's home, this conversation's session by its short id, linked to its page, with the conversation's name, and what waits on you in the project, linked to its inbox, only while something does; it fits the terminal's width, the name cut at a word or left out; the held request names a 25 s hold; in a repo new to devcorner the line says /dc setup sets it up and /dc hide hides the offer; for the minute after a deploy of devcorner the line says devcorner is updating, and the plugin waits as long as devcorner asked before it asks again; /dc says the project's picture as text (Project home, Active actions and In flight first, then the session's ticket, the paste to copy, your other live sessions, what waits on you by work stream, the newest first, the OA, what is moving, cloud sessions, Next and the code against the last deploy, each under a short lower-case label, then their pages), says which person and machine this is, or asks devcorner something; /dc now says what the session is on and did lately (its ticket, its latest note, its last moves, its open questions and its runs out); when an agent of this conversation writes a paste for you, the transcript says so in one line, /dc paste copies it and /dc pastes lists yours; /dc waits lists what waits on you by work stream; /dc sessions lists your live sessions in every project, and /dc send <to> <text> sends your own words, typed here, to another conversation or session of yours, in any project, which wakes for them while it is idle. A machine signs itself in from Claude Code: /dc login shows a code to approve on devcorner's /device page, or Claude approves that code through its own devcorner connection when asked, as the line above the prompt says while signed out, and the plugin keeps the hook token devcorner makes for this machine in the plugin's own store, never in settings.json; /dc logout revokes it. DEVCORNER_TOKEN in the environment still wins. With no token, as in a cloud session, which is never signed in, the plugin adds the Claude account's capacity, when a reading is due, to a devcorner call the session makes anyway.
